qa_method: Article-by-article review of the P1-003 internal Chinese RETRANSLATIONS against the official Arabic governing text, using the official English only as secondary guidance. Review only — no P1-003 Chinese text or remediation data was modified. Hashes/references only; no full Arabic/English/Chinese text embedded.
